title: Saltreach Fen - Tidecall Channels
_note: Option C relit/deep-water variant. gbc 4-voice band. 6/8 compound, 108bpm, brightening D major with a wistful minor turn. Clearer warmer pulse25 lilting waltz-feel lead, more confident than A; pulse12 proper bell-buoy chime arpeggios (fast broken major triads = chip 'chord'), dewy and ringing; rocking compound tri_bass with a touch more propulsion; soft drums - kick-on-one with light offbeat hat, a chime-tap (ohat) at the seam. Vesper states the spine cleanly in major: A3->D4->E4 ... F#4->E4->D4, the overshoot lands hopeful. 24 bars in 6/8.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Confident lilting waltz-feel line. Vesper in major: lift A3->D4->E4, settle F#4->E4->D4 lands hopeful. One wistful B-minor turn in the bridge.
